title: MCAT integrated review
prerequisites: C2, C4, C6, C8, C9, C11, C12; helpful: C10.
purpose: Review every MCAT section with passage-based practice: biology, biochemistry, general and organic chemistry, physics, psychology and sociology, research design and statistics, critical reading and data interpretation.
primary_reading: AAMC: What's on the MCAT exam?

weeks.2: Biology review: cells, genetics and organ systems

blocks.deliverable: Build a study plan from a diagnostic.
Complete two timed passage sets and log your errors.
Complete two timed passage sets and log your errors.
Week 7 midterm; interpret the design and figures of an experiment passage.
Complete a full mixed block under time.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Timed practice block: complete a supplied mixed set under time, log every error by cause, and build a two-week repair plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
